$comment: Where every file here came from, and what it may be redistributed under.
This repository is public and permanent. Committing to it is republishing,
and a public repository cannot be un-published by deleting a file — so the
rule is that nothing arrives without its terms arriving with it.
scripts/validate.mjs refuses a tracked file that no entry below covers.
There is deliberately no catch-all: adding a directory means adding an
entry, and adding an entry for somebody else's data means answering the
`redistribution` question in a sentence. The guard is not that a machine
can check the answer. It is that the answer has to exist before the data
assets/logos/ is deliberately absent. The README describes it and
.gitattributes has rules for it, but nothing is committed there yet — and
a publisher's mark is a trademark rather than a licensable work, which is
the hardest case in this repository. The first commit of one will fail
validation until somebody writes down what it rests on.
